cands.name: Jonathan Albert
cands.bio: Republican, first-term House member since Nov. 2024; born in Winter Haven in 1979. Nearly 10 years in the Marine Corps; MBA; business owner; Mayor of Frostproof 2020-24.

record.text: Mayor of Frostproof 2020-2024; House District 48 since Nov. 2024 (succeeded Sam Killebrew).
Filed a bill in 2025 to help tenants stay cool in hot weather (per Florida Politics headline).

cands.gaps: No donor reporting, endorsements or controversies found. Owner sources: only alexjoneslive.com on-site search was run for this name (no results); stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com on-site searches are bot-blocked and the web-search budget ran out, so those were not checked.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
